chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿUmar ibn Saʿīd, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام, who said:

I heard him saying: I enshrouded my father in two Shatwānī garments in which he used to enter ihram, and in a shirt from among his shirts, and in a turban that had belonged to ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, and in a cloak which he had purchased for forty dinars.

key_terms.ثَوْبَيْنِ: two garments used as part of the shrouding
key_terms.دِينَارًا: a gold coin; here indicating the purchase price
key_terms.شَطَوِيَّيْنِ: two garments of Shatwānī cloth, a known type of fabric
key_terms.عِمَامَةٍ: a turban included in the shrouding
key_terms.قَمِيصٍ: a shirt used among the burial cloths
key_terms.كَفَّنْتُ: I enshrouded; prepared the burial shroud for the deceased
key_terms.يُحْرِمُ: he would enter into ihram using them

ai.seo_question: How was the father of the Imam عليه السلام enshrouded according to this hadith in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This report describes how the Imam عليه السلام enshrouded his father using specific garments associated with his personal worship and family inheritance. It preserves a biographical detail about the funeral preparations of an Imam and reflects continuity with the legacy of Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
